message.text: My Kubernetes application deployment is failing after the latest CI/CD build.

workflow_steps.detail: Switch protocol routed task to DevOps Engineer (OpenAI Codex)

dispatch.instruction: Analyze CI/CD pipeline build logs and deployment failure

context.failure_symptom: Pod CrashLoopBackOff: exit code 137 (OOMKilled) + liveness probe timeout

workflow_steps.detail: OpenAI Codex completed log inspection and identified JVM memory cgroup limit mismatch

message.text:
🔍 [DevOps Engineer - OpenAI Codex Analysis]
• Build #402 Log Inspection: Container image `registry.internal/payments:v2.4.1` compiled successfully.
• Runtime Failure: Pod crashed with Exit Code 137 (OOMKilled) after 14 seconds.
• Root Cause: In `deploy/kubernetes/deployment.yaml`, memory limit is configured at `128Mi` while JVM heap `-Xmx256m` exceeds container cgroup limit.
• Recommended Fix: Increase `resources.limits.memory` to `512Mi` and set `resources.requests.memory` to `256Mi`.

workflow_steps.detail: Kubernetes Engineer audited manifest probes and verified OOMKilled cgroup limits

message.text:
⚙️ [Kubernetes Engineer Manifest Audit]
• Audited `payments-api-deployment.yaml` in cluster `k8s-prod-us-east-1`:
  - `initialDelaySeconds` on `livenessProbe` is set to 3s (insufficient for Spring Boot bootstrap; requires min 30s).
  - Missing `readinessProbe` causing premature ingress traffic routing during pod boot.
• Remediation Patch prepared: Added proper startupProbe & aligned memory limit to 512Mi.

workflow_steps.detail: Incident Coordinator consolidated agent findings and published incident report to Mattermost #devops-alerts

message.text:
📋 [Incident Coordinator Resolution Report]
• Severity: P2 - Deployment Degradation
• Affected Service: payments-api (k8s-prod-us-east-1)
• Root Causes: 1) Container OOMKilled (128Mi limit vs 256m JVM heap); 2) Premature liveness probe.
• Automated Fix Applied: Generated pull request #148 with corrected resource allocations and probes.
• Status: Resolved & Verified in Staging. Ready for production rollout.
